content: Mid-write partial reads: FS events fire at the START of a write, not the end - reading in the handler yields truncated content. Standard fix: settle check per path (stat size+mtime stable for N consecutive samples) before processing; chokidar awaitWriteFinish uses stabilityThreshold~500-2000ms pollInterval~100ms. Critical scaling lesson (openclaw PR #81802): polling the WHOLE tree for write-finish held FDs for every file -> EBADF spawn failures on large MD trees; fix = record only changed paths from events, then settle-check just those paths after debounce (FD cost O(N)->0). mtime lies: copy tools preserve source mtime and clocks differ - measure age from first-seen not mtime; settle window (interval x rounds) must exceed longest producer mid-write pause; stillness proves nothing about completeness - verify content after (SIF's sha256 checksum serves this). Sources: sysax size-stability guide, SO chokidar 34750158, github usrcp-obsidian watcher, openclaw PR 81802, tailwindcss PR 5758.
